description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding to be used as a family room following the demolition of existing double garage
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (455 Rev C, 405 Rev B, 010 Rev B, Planning Statement ref 1499-1.0, 305 Rev C, 205 Rev C, 100 Rev B, 015 Rev B; received 26/06/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be constructed with brick walls, a timber and felt roof and a timber front door.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the outbuilding hereby approved.
Condition : 5 - Any guttering fitted to the outbuilding hereby approved shall not project outside the boundary of the site.

Condition : 6 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for purposes as a family room incidental to the enjoyment of the main house as shown on approved drawing number 2015 Rev: C and for no other purpose.   The outbuilding shall not be used as a self-contained dwelling, or be converted to include a bedroom, kitchen, living room or other primary residential accommodation, or be converted for use as an office for business purposes.
